levelNames.note: All three names match the expected strings word for word, including 'customized'. The report presents three levels, under the heading 'the integration of AI into strategic foresight processes in general', not one per practice; assigning a level per practice is the thesis's rule. O-3: the report names the practices as 'horizon scanning', 'trend analysis or clustering' and 'scenario development' (Figure 2, p. 8; foreword p. 3: 'scanning, analysis and scenario development'), and these are its three most-cited AI uses (60%, 69%, 63%). R2's 'scanning, trend analysis, scenario work' matches in substance. The report says 'scenario development', not 'scenario work'. maturity.status not touched; Miguel sets it at G3.
